itens.titulo: New drug reverses severe fatty liver disease by repairing the gut
itens.resumo: Scientists have discovered that a potential new drug can reverse severe fatty liver disease in animal models by restoring gut health and blocking harmful substances from reaching the liver. The breakthrough could pave the way for new treatments for liver disease and potentially other serious conditions, including cardiovascular disease.

itens.titulo: "Mind-blowing" Alzheimer’s breakthrough: Two hours of sleep restored without clearing brain plaques
itens.resumo: Scientists have uncovered an unexpected culprit behind sleep loss in Alzheimer’s disease: overactive immune cells in the brain. By temporarily removing these cells, researchers restored more than two hours of sleep per day in mice, revealing a promising new target for treatment.

itens.titulo: Scientists link a strange sugar in red meat to a 63% higher diabetes risk
itens.resumo: A study of nearly 90,000 adults found that people consuming the most of a little-known sugar found in red meat had a 63% higher risk of developing type 2 diabetes. Scientists suspect the sugar may trigger chronic inflammation, potentially revealing a hidden connection between red meat and diabetes that goes beyond weight gain.

itens.titulo: Scientists discover why some people still can’t taste food after COVID-19
itens.resumo: Scientists have uncovered a possible explanation for why some people struggle to taste food more than a year after recovering from COVID-19. By examining taste buds from patients with lingering symptoms, researchers discovered molecular abnormalities that weaken the signals responsible for detecting sweet, bitter, and savory flavors.

itens.titulo: Scientists tested 39 sweeteners and uncovered surprising gut effects
itens.resumo: Scientists have discovered that many common sweeteners can interfere with gut bacteria, with some combinations involving medications producing surprisingly strong effects. One sweetener mixed with a widely prescribed antidepressant reduced beneficial bacteria and microbial diversity in laboratory experiments, raising new questions about potential effects on gut health and immunity.

itens.titulo: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
